primary_title: Direct binding of Smad3 and Smad4 to critical TGF beta-inducible elements in the promoter of human plasminogen activator inhibitor-type 1 gene
decision_basis: The review identifies primary evidence that a TGF-beta-induced SMAD3/SMAD4 nuclear complex binds CAGA boxes in the human SERPINE1/PAI-1 promoter and activates transcription.
limitations_preserved: Record SERPINE1/PAI-1 as gene transcription only; the primary does not by itself establish secreted PAI-1 protein abundance, extracellular activity, or a same-cell SERPINE1-to-LRP1 relay.

primary_title: Involvement of the IRF family transcription factor IRF-3 in virus-induced activation of the IFN-beta gene; Virus infection induces assembly of coordinately activated transcription factors on IFN-beta enhancer in vivo; The mechanism of transcriptional synergy of an in vitro assembled interferon-beta enhanceosome
decision_basis: The review traces primary evidence that virus-activated IRF3, together with CBP/p300 and the IFNB1 enhanceosome, drives interferon-beta gene transcription.
limitations_preserved: Record IFNB1/interferon-beta as gene transcription, not secreted IFN-beta protein; preserve viral/innate-stimulus, NF-kappa-B/ATF2-cJun/CBP-p300 enhanceosome context and do not claim isolated IRF3 sufficiency or terminal-TF output.

primary_title: Synergistic activation of inflammatory cytokine genes by interferon-gamma-induced chromatin remodeling and toll-like receptor signaling
decision_basis: The review-led primary study shows STAT1 occupancy at CXCL10 regulatory elements after IFN-gamma stimulation and links STAT1-associated chromatin priming to inflammatory CXCL10 transcription in macrophages.
limitations_preserved: Record CXCL10 as gene transcription, not secreted CXCL10 protein; preserve IFN-gamma priming, TLR/cofactor/chromatin context and STAT1 occupancy/activation association, without claiming STAT1 alone is sufficient or inferring SCI/terminal-TF effects.

primary_title: IL-6 signaling via the STAT3/SOCS3 pathway: functional analysis of the conserved STAT3 N-domain
decision_basis: The review identifies primary reconstitution and promoter evidence that IL-6-activated STAT3 binds the SOCS3 promoter and activates endogenous SOCS3 expression as negative feedback.
limitations_preserved: Record SOCS3 as gene transcription/negative feedback, not a secreted output; preserve IL-6/STAT3 and promoter-site context, and do not infer that the STAT3 N-domain or a single STAT3 dimer is uniquely required in every cell type.

primary_title: CTGF and SMADs, maintenance of scleroderma phenotype is independent of SMAD signaling
decision_basis: The reviews cite primary promoter-mutagenesis and fibroblast evidence that TGF-beta-induced CCN2/CTGF transcription depends on SMAD3 and SMAD4 binding to a functional SMAD element.
limitations_preserved: Record CCN2/CTGF as gene transcription only; preserve normal-versus-scleroderma fibroblast and TGF-beta context, and do not infer secreted CTGF protein, matrix deposition, or SCI-specific fibrosis from this promoter evidence alone.

primary_title: Smad3 and Smad4 cooperate with c-Jun/c-Fos to mediate TGF-beta-induced transcription
decision_basis: The reviews identify primary evidence that a SMAD3-SMAD4 complex and AP-1 cooperate at the c-Jun promoter to activate TGF-beta-responsive transcription.
limitations_preserved: Record JUN/c-Jun as gene transcription; preserve the AP-1 cofactor and TGF-beta-responsive promoter context, and do not infer a standalone SMAD3-SMAD4-only effect or downstream c-Jun protein abundance.

primary_title: Virus infection induces assembly of coordinately activated transcription factors on the IFN-beta enhancer in vivo; An atomic model of the interferon-beta enhanceosome
decision_basis: The review traces primary evidence that coordinated IRF3/IRF7, NF-kappa-B and cofactor occupancy at the IFNB1 enhancer forms the functional enhanceosome that activates interferon-beta transcription.
limitations_preserved: Record IFNB1/interferon-beta as gene transcription, not secreted IFN-beta protein; preserve the multicomponent enhancer, viral/innate stimulus and cofactor geometry, and do not split the enhanceosome into unsupported independent site effects.

primary_title: Role of Stat3 in lipopolysaccharide-induced IL-10 gene expression
decision_basis: The review cites primary promoter and perturbation evidence that STAT3 binds a defined human IL10 promoter motif and controls LPS-induced IL10 transcription.
limitations_preserved: Record IL10 as gene transcription, not secreted IL-10 protein; preserve the human promoter, LPS stimulus and STAT3-dependent site context, and do not infer universal STAT3 sufficiency or protein secretion from promoter evidence alone.

primary_title: Transcription factors NF-IL6 and NF-kappa B synergistically activate transcription of the inflammatory cytokines, interleukin 6 and interleukin 8
decision_basis: The review identifies primary evidence that NF-IL6/C-EBPbeta and NF-kappa-B p65 cooperate at defined IL6 promoter elements to activate transcription.
limitations_preserved: Record IL6 as gene transcription, not secreted IL-6 protein; preserve the NF-IL6/C-EBPbeta plus p65 cooperative promoter context and do not split the complex into unsupported unary NF-kappa-B or C/EBPbeta sufficiency.

primary_title: Transcription factors NF-IL6 and NF-kappa B synergistically activate transcription of the inflammatory cytokines, interleukin 6 and interleukin 8
decision_basis: The review cites the same primary promoter study showing NF-IL6/C-EBPbeta and NF-kappa-B p65 synergistically activate CXCL8/IL-8 transcription through cooperative promoter elements.
limitations_preserved: Record CXCL8/IL-8 as gene transcription, not secreted IL-8 protein; preserve the cooperative NF-IL6/C-EBPbeta plus p65 promoter context and do not split the complex into unsupported unary factor sufficiency.

primary_title: Nuclear factor-kappa B p65 mediates the assembly and activation of the TNF-responsive element of the murine monocyte chemoattractant-1 gene
decision_basis: The reviews identify primary enhancer-mutagenesis, p65 complementation and promoter-occupancy evidence that an NF-kappa-B p65-containing complex activates CCL2/MCP-1 transcription.
limitations_preserved: Record CCL2/MCP-1 as gene transcription, not secreted CCL2 protein; preserve the TNF, distal kappa-B enhancer and proximal SP1 context and do not reduce the multi-element enhancer to a universal unary p65 rule.

primary_title: c-Jun controls histone modifications, NF-kappaB recruitment, and RNA polymerase II function to activate the ccl2 gene
decision_basis: The reviews describe primary ChIP, loss-of-function and promoter-mutagenesis evidence that c-Jun/AP-1, including c-Jun-ATF2 dimers, contributes to IL-1-induced CCL2 transcription.
limitations_preserved: Record CCL2 as gene transcription, not secreted CCL2 protein; preserve IL-1/JNK, c-Jun phosphorylation, ATF2 and NF-kappa-B chromatin-cooperation context and do not infer a standalone c-Jun-only effect.

primary_title: NF-kappa B and STAT1 control CXCL1 and CXCL2 gene transcription
decision_basis: The review-guided primary study shows p65/p50 recruitment to conserved CXCL1 promoter kappa-B elements and loss of IL-1-induced CXCL1 transcription after NF-kappa-B-site mutation or p65/p50 perturbation.
limitations_preserved: Record CXCL1 as gene transcription, not secreted CXCL1 protein; preserve IL-1 stimulus and STAT1 cooperation/parallel signaling in the primary assay, and do not claim p65/p50 alone explains all CXCL1 induction.

primary_title: NF-kappa B and STAT1 control CXCL1 and CXCL2 gene transcription
decision_basis: The review-guided primary study shows p65/p50 recruitment to conserved CXCL2 promoter kappa-B elements and loss of IL-1-induced CXCL2 transcription after NF-kappa-B-site mutation or p65/p50 perturbation.
limitations_preserved: Record CXCL2 as gene transcription, not secreted CXCL2 protein; preserve IL-1 stimulus and STAT1 cooperation/parallel signaling in the primary assay, and do not claim p65/p50 alone explains all CXCL2 induction.

primary_title: General involvement of hypoxia-inducible factor 1 in transcriptional response to hypoxia
decision_basis: The reviews trace primary HIF-1 DNA-binding and enhancer-mutagenesis evidence showing that HIF-1 binding to the EPO hypoxia-response element is required for hypoxic EPO transcription.
limitations_preserved: Record EPO as gene transcription, not secreted erythropoietin protein; preserve the HIF1A/ARNT heterodimer, hypoxia, 3-prime enhancer HRE and hepatoma context; do not substitute EPAS1/HIF-2alpha or infer erythropoietic output from promoter evidence alone.

primary_title: BNIP3 plays a role in hypoxic cell death in human epithelial cells that is inhibited by growth factors EGF and IGF
decision_basis: The review cites primary HIF-1alpha promoter-HRE binding and mutation evidence showing that hypoxia-induced BNIP3 transcription depends on a functional HIF-responsive element.
limitations_preserved: Record BNIP3 as gene transcription, not BNIP3 protein or autophagy/apoptosis output; preserve hypoxia/HRE and human epithelial context; do not infer HIF1A-only sufficiency when ARNT/cofactors are not separately resolved.

primary_title: Hypoxia-inducible expression of tumor-associated carbonic anhydrases
decision_basis: The reviews cite primary promoter and HRE evidence identifying CA9 as a HIF-1-responsive gene with a functional HIF-dependent hypoxia-response element.
limitations_preserved: Record CA9 as gene transcription, not CA9 protein or pH/tumor-growth output; preserve HIF-1/VHL and hypoxia or VHL-loss context; do not treat HIF-1 as the only regulator under all density or PI3K conditions.

primary_title: Formation of STAT1-STAT2 heterodimers and their role in the activation of IRF-1 gene transcription by interferon-alpha; Tyrosine phosphorylated p91 binds to a single element in the ISGF2/IRF-1 promoter
decision_basis: The reviews identify STAT1 homodimers as binding the interferon-responsive IRF1 promoter element and driving IRF1 transcription.
limitations_preserved: Record IRF1 as gene transcription, not IRF1 protein; preserve interferon-alpha versus interferon-gamma, STAT1 homodimer and IR promoter-element context; the primary also supports STAT1-STAT2, so do not claim homodimer exclusivity or terminal-TF output.

primary_title: Formation of STAT1-STAT2 heterodimers and their role in the activation of IRF-1 gene transcription by interferon-alpha
decision_basis: The reviews trace primary evidence that an interferon-induced STAT1-STAT2 heterodimer binds the IRF1 promoter element and activates IRF1 transcription, with greater potency than STAT1 homodimers in the tested system.
limitations_preserved: Record IRF1 as gene transcription, not IRF1 protein; preserve STAT1-STAT2 heterodimer, interferon-alpha and IR promoter-element context; do not substitute ISGF3/p48 or infer terminal-TF output.

primary_title: Distinct modes of action applied by transcription factors STAT1 and IRF1 to initiate transcription of the IFN-gamma-inducible gbp2 gene
decision_basis: The reviews identify GBP2 as a cooperative STAT1/IRF1-dependent transcriptional target; the cited primary shows both factors at the GBP2 promoter and requires both for RNA polymerase II recruitment and full transcriptional activation.
limitations_preserved: Record GBP2 as gene transcription, not GBP2 protein or antimicrobial output; preserve that STAT1 and IRF1 perform complementary promoter functions and are not proven here to form a stable heterodimer; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: A unique ISRE in the human Isg20 promoter confers IRF-1-mediated responsiveness to both interferon type I and type II; The exonuclease ISG20 is directly induced by synthetic dsRNA via NF-kappaB and IRF1 activation
decision_basis: The reviews trace primary promoter and response-element studies showing IRF1-dependent ISG20 transcription in type-I/type-II interferon and synthetic-dsRNA responses.
limitations_preserved: Record ISG20 as gene transcription, not ISG20 protein or antiviral output; preserve IRF1 dependence and the co-regulatory roles of Sp1/USF1 or NF-kappaB in the cited promoter systems; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: NF-kappa B/Rel family members regulating the ICAM-1 promoter in monocytic THP-1 cells
decision_basis: The reviews identify NF-kappaB response elements in the ICAM1 promoter; the cited primary shows TNF-alpha-induced RelA-containing complexes bind the ICAM1 kappa-B site and RelA/c-Rel family members transactivate the reporter.
limitations_preserved: Record ICAM1/CD54 as gene transcription, not surface ICAM1 abundance or integrin adhesion output; preserve stimulus- and cell-type-dependent RelA/c-Rel/NF-kappaB1 composition and do not claim a single universal NF-kappaB dimer.

primary_title: NF-kappaB regulates thrombin-induced ICAM-1 gene expression in cooperation with NFAT by binding to the intronic NF-kappaB site in the ICAM-1 gene
decision_basis: The review traces primary evidence that p65/RelA and NFATc1 co-occupy an intronic NF-kappaB site in the ICAM1 gene and that site mutation reduces stimulus-induced transcription.
limitations_preserved: Record ICAM1/CD54 as gene transcription, not surface ICAM1 protein or leukocyte-adhesion output; preserve thrombin/PAR1 endothelial context and cooperative p65-NFATc1 occupancy at intron 1; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Tumor necrosis factor-alpha augments matrix metalloproteinase-9 production in skeletal muscle cells through TAK1-dependent signaling; Matrix metalloproteinase 9 expression is induced by Epstein-Barr virus latent membrane protein 1 activation regions
decision_basis: The reviews identify AP-1 and NF-kappaB elements as major MMP9 regulatory sites; the cited primary shows TNF-alpha-induced MMP9 promoter activity and expression require intact AP-1 and NF-kappaB sites and are blocked by dominant-negative pathway inhibitors.
limitations_preserved: Record MMP9 as gene transcription, not secreted MMP9 protein, protease activity or LRP1 signaling; preserve that AP-1 and NF-kappaB are cooperating promoter inputs and that cell stimulus/context differs across the cited systems; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Distinct modes of action applied by transcription factors STAT1 and IRF1 to initiate transcription of the IFN-gamma-inducible gbp2 gene
decision_basis: The reviews identify STAT1 as a direct GBP2 promoter factor that establishes permissive chromatin and is required for efficient RNA polymerase II recruitment and IFN-gamma-induced GBP2 transcription.
limitations_preserved: Record GBP2 as gene transcription, not GBP2 protein or antimicrobial output; preserve the requirement for cooperating IRF1, STAT1 S727/chromatin context and IFN-gamma stimulation; STAT1 alone is not claimed sufficient and no SCI or terminal-TF inference is made.

primary_title: Distinct modes of action applied by transcription factors STAT1 and IRF1 to initiate transcription of the IFN-gamma-inducible gbp2 gene; Interferon regulatory factor 1 is required for mouse Gbp gene activation by gamma interferon
decision_basis: The reviews identify IRF1 as an essential GBP2 promoter factor; the cited primary shows IRF1 promoter association and loss of full GBP2 transcriptional activation or inducibility when IRF1 is absent.
limitations_preserved: Record GBP2 as gene transcription, not GBP2 protein or antimicrobial output; preserve STAT1 cooperation, IRF1 dependence and IFN-gamma context; the evidence does not establish IRF1-only sufficiency or a stable STAT1-IRF1 heterodimer and gives no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Characterization of a functional NF-kappa B site in the human interleukin 1 beta promoter; NF-kappa B regulates IL-1 beta transcription through a consensus NF-kappa B binding site and a nonconsensus CRE-like site
decision_basis: The reviews identify NF-kappaB/Rel binding in the IL1B promoter; the cited primary studies show RelA, c-Rel and p50-containing complexes bind functional promoter elements and activate IL1B transcription in inducible myeloid-cell systems.
limitations_preserved: Record IL1B as gene transcription, not mature IL-1beta secretion or receptor activation; preserve the promoter's multiple NF-kappaB/CRE elements, stimulus dependence and RelA/c-Rel/p50 composition; any gene-to-protein-to-receptor relay requires separate evidence and no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: IFNbeta-dependent increases in STAT1, STAT2, and IRF9 mediate resistance to viruses and DNA damage
decision_basis: The reviews describe ISGF3 as the canonical STAT1-STAT2-IRF9 complex that binds ISRE-containing antiviral promoters; the cited primary study shows IFN-beta-induced OAS2 transcription with STAT1, STAT2 and IRF9 occupancy at the OAS2 regulatory region.
limitations_preserved: Record OAS2 as gene transcription, not OAS2 protein or antiviral function; preserve IFN-beta stimulation, ISGF3/U-ISGF3 time/state and human-cell context; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: IFNbeta-dependent increases in STAT1, STAT2, and IRF9 mediate resistance to viruses and DNA damage
decision_basis: The reviews describe ISGF3-mediated ISRE transcription; the cited primary study shows IFN-beta-induced MX1 transcription and STAT1, STAT2 and IRF9 occupancy at the MX1 regulatory region.
limitations_preserved: Record MX1 as gene transcription, not MX1 protein or antiviral function; preserve IFN-beta stimulation, ISGF3/U-ISGF3 time/state and human-cell context; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: IFNbeta-dependent increases in STAT1, STAT2, and IRF9 mediate resistance to viruses and DNA damage
decision_basis: The reviews describe ISGF3-mediated ISRE transcription; the cited primary study shows IFN-beta-induced IFI27 transcription and STAT1, STAT2 and IRF9 occupancy at the IFI27 regulatory region.
limitations_preserved: Record IFI27 as gene transcription, not IFI27 protein or antiviral function; preserve IFN-beta stimulation, ISGF3/U-ISGF3 time/state and human-cell context; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Epstein-Barr virus independent dysregulation of UBP43 expression alters interferon-stimulated gene expression in Burkitt lymphoma; Role of metazoan mediator proteins in interferon-responsive transcription
decision_basis: The reviews identify ISG15 as an ISRE-regulated interferon-stimulated gene; the cited primary studies show IFN-alpha-responsive ISG15 promoter activity and ISGF3 binding to the ISG15 ISRE in human Burkitt-lymphoma/HeLa-derived systems.
limitations_preserved: Record ISG15 as gene transcription, not free or conjugated ISG15 protein, extracellular ISG15 secretion, or LFA-1 activation; preserve IFN-alpha and ISRE context; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Role of metazoan mediator proteins in interferon-responsive transcription; Cooperative Transcriptional Activation of Antimicrobial Genes by STAT and NF-kappaB Pathways by Concerted Recruitment of the Mediator Complex
decision_basis: The reviews describe ISGF3 binding to ISRE-containing antiviral promoters; the cited primary study demonstrates IFN-dependent ISGF3/Mediator recruitment and transcriptional activation at the ISG54/IFIT2 promoter.
limitations_preserved: Record IFIT2/ISG54 as gene transcription, not IFIT2 protein or antiviral function; preserve the ISG54 synonym, ISRE and Mediator/cofactor context; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Cooperative Transcriptional Activation of Antimicrobial Genes by STAT and NF-kappaB Pathways by Concerted Recruitment of the Mediator Complex; Nonconventional Initiation Complex Assembly by STAT and NF-kappaB Transcription Factors Regulates Nitric Oxide Synthase Expression
decision_basis: The reviews describe cooperative STAT/NF-kappaB regulation of Nos2; the cited primary studies show ISGF3 and NF-kappaB jointly recruit transcription machinery and are required for inducible Nos2 transcription in Listeria-infected murine macrophages.
limitations_preserved: Record NOS2 as gene transcription, not iNOS protein, nitric-oxide production or antimicrobial function; preserve Listeria/IFN-I and pattern-recognition co-stimulation, ISGF3 and NF-kappaB cooperation, and no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Tumour necrosis factor-alpha and interferon-gamma synergistically activate the RANTES promoter through nuclear factor kappaB and interferon regulatory factor 1 transcription factors
decision_basis: The reviews describe adjacent NF-kappaB and IRF promoter modules in CCL5/RANTES regulation; the cited primary study shows NF-kappaB and IRF1-dependent CCL5 promoter activation, site-mutant loss and synergistic induction by TNF-alpha plus IFN-gamma.
limitations_preserved: Record CCL5 as gene transcription, not secreted CCL5 protein or chemokine-receptor activation; preserve NF-kappaB/IRF1 cooperation, TNF-alpha/IFN-gamma stimulus and promoter-element context; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Direct, Interferon-Independent Activation of the CXCL10 Promoter by NF-kappaB and Interferon Regulatory Factor 3 during Hepatitis C Virus Infection
decision_basis: The reviews identify concerted NF-kappaB/IRF3 control of antiviral chemokine promoters; the cited primary study demonstrates NF-kappaB and IRF3 recruitment and site-dependent activation of the CXCL10 promoter during HCV and PRR-PAMP stimulation.
limitations_preserved: Record CXCL10 as gene transcription, not secreted CXCL10 protein or CXCR3 activation; preserve HCV/PRR stimulus, NF-kappaB and IRF3 promoter cooperation and hepatocyte context; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: An upstream positive regulatory element in human GM-CSF promoter is recognized by NF-kappa B/Rel family members; The regulation of GM-CSF is dependent on a complex interplay between multiple transcription factors
decision_basis: The review describes inducible NF-kappaB/Rel and AP-1 control of GM-CSF transcription; the cited primary promoter studies identify positive NF-kappaB/Rel-responsive elements in the human CSF2/GM-CSF promoter and NF-kappaB/Rel binding to the regulatory region.
limitations_preserved: Record CSF2 as gene transcription, not secreted GM-CSF protein or CSF2 receptor activation; preserve NF-kappaB/Rel-family composition and T-cell promoter context; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Mechanism of rapid transcriptional induction of tumor necrosis factor alpha-responsive genes by NF-kappaB
decision_basis: The reviews identify TNFAIP3/A20 as an NF-kappaB-induced negative-feedback gene; the cited primary study shows p65/NF-kappaB association with the A20 promoter, NF-kappaB-site dependence and TNF-alpha-induced transcriptional reinitiation.
limitations_preserved: Record TNFAIP3/A20 as gene transcription, not A20 protein abundance or downstream deubiquitinase function; preserve Sp1/core-promoter cooperation and TNF-alpha/Jurkat context; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Requirement for nuclear factor (NF)-kappa B p65 and NF-interleukin-6 binding elements in the tumor necrosis factor response region of the granulocyte colony-stimulating factor promoter
decision_basis: The review identifies NF-kappaB and NF-IL6 elements in the G-CSF/CSF3 TNF-response region; the cited primary study shows p65 binding and activation of the CSF3 promoter with cooperative NF-IL6-site dependence.
limitations_preserved: Record CSF3 as gene transcription, not secreted G-CSF protein or CSF3R activation; preserve the TNF-response region, p65/NF-IL6 cooperation and cell-specific promoter context; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Transcriptional activation of the human TNF-alpha promoter by superantigen in human monocytic cells: role of NF-kappa B
decision_basis: The review describes stimulus- and cell-context-dependent NF-kappaB regulation of TNF transcription; the cited primary study shows p50/p65 binding to the proximal kappa3 TNF promoter site and site-dependent promoter induction in superantigen- or LPS-stimulated THP-1 cells.
limitations_preserved: Record TNF as gene transcription, not TNF protein secretion or TNFR activation; preserve the proximal kappa3 promoter site and SEA/LPS THP-1 stimulus context because TNF promoter regulation is stimulus- and cell-dependent; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Promoter of the human NF-kappa B p50/p105 gene. Regulation by NF-kappa B subunits and by c-REL
decision_basis: The reviews describe NF-kappaB family autoregulation and p50 precursor biology; the cited primary study shows p50/p65- and c-Rel-dependent activation of the NFKB1/p50-p105 promoter, an NF-kappaB promoter-binding site, and inhibition by I-kappaB.
limitations_preserved: Record NFKB1 as precursor-gene transcription, not p50 processing or universal NF-kappaB activation; preserve p50/p105 precursor and p50/p65/c-Rel composition boundaries; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Interferon-Dependent Expression of the Human STAT1 Gene Requires a Distal Regulatory Region Located Approximately 6 kb Upstream for Its Autoregulatory System
decision_basis: The reviews describe ISRE-mediated positive feedback at the STAT1 locus; the cited primary study shows that an IFN-responsive distal 5.5-kb regulatory region containing an ISRE is required for IFN-alpha-induced STAT1 transcription in genome-edited human cells and full-length promoter assays.
limitations_preserved: Record STAT1 as gene transcription, not STAT1 protein abundance or generalized IFN signaling; preserve the distal 5.5-kb ISRE enhancer, IFN-alpha/ISGF3 context and human-cell model; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Interferon-Dependent Expression of the Human STAT1 Gene Requires a Distal Regulatory Region Located Approximately 6 kb Upstream for Its Autoregulatory System
decision_basis: The reviews describe GAS-mediated positive feedback at the STAT1 locus; the cited primary study shows that an IFN-responsive distal 5.5-kb regulatory region containing a GAS is required for IFN-gamma-induced STAT1 transcription in genome-edited human cells and full-length promoter assays.
limitations_preserved: Record STAT1 as gene transcription, not STAT1 protein abundance or generalized IFN signaling; preserve the distal 5.5-kb GAS enhancer, IFN-gamma/GAF context and human-cell model; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Tissue-Specific Autoregulation of the stat3 Gene and Its Role in Interleukin-6-Induced Survival Signals in T Cells
decision_basis: The reviews describe STAT3 autoregulation through a promoter STAT3-binding element; the cited primary study shows IL-6-dependent STAT3 promoter activation, in-vivo SBE mutation effects and tissue-specific STAT3 gene induction in mice.
limitations_preserved: Record STAT3 as gene transcription, not STAT3 protein abundance or universal IL-6 response; preserve the low-affinity SBE, IL-6-responsive tissue-specific mechanism and mouse T-cell/peripheral-tissue context; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Glucocorticoid receptor-mediated suppression of the interleukin-2 gene expression through impairment of the cooperativity between nuclear factor of activated T cells and AP-1 enhancer elements; Characterization of the sequence and architectural constraints of the regulatory and core regions of the human interleukin-2 promoter
decision_basis: The review describes cooperative NFAT/AP-1 control of the IL-2 promoter; the cited promoter studies show NFAT/AP-1 composite-element dependence and stimulus-dependent IL2 promoter reporter activation in T-cell systems.
limitations_preserved: Record IL2 as gene transcription, not IL-2 protein secretion or IL2 receptor activation; preserve the NFAT/AP-1 composite promoter, TCR/costimulation or PMA/ionomycin context and no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: IL-21 IS PRODUCED BY TH17 CELLS AND DRIVES IL-17 PRODUCTION IN A STAT3-DEPENDENT MANNER
decision_basis: The reviews identify IL21 as a direct STAT3 target in Th17 cells; the cited primary study shows Th17-selective Stat3-dependent Il21 mRNA/protein production and Stat3 enrichment at the Il21 promoter.
limitations_preserved: Record IL21 as gene transcription, not an automatic secretion or receptor-activation edge; preserve Th17/Stat3 context and distinguish the separate IL-21 protein autocrine function shown in the primary; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Regulation of the IL-23 and IL-12 balance by Stat3 signaling in the tumor microenvironment
decision_basis: The review describes STAT3 regulation of inflammatory cytokine genes; the cited primary study shows Stat3-dependent IL-23/p19 transcription, promoter-reporter activation, Stat3 promoter occupancy and myeloid/tumor-context IL-23 production.
limitations_preserved: Record IL23A/p19 as gene transcription, not automatically secreted IL-23 protein or IL-23 receptor activation; preserve tumor-associated myeloid and tumor-cell context and the shared p40/IL12B requirement for assembled IL-23 protein; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Regulation of the IL-23 and IL-12 balance by Stat3 signaling in the tumor microenvironment
decision_basis: The review identifies cooperative inflammatory transcriptional regulation; the cited primary study shows Stat3 and NF-kappaB/p65 occupancy at the IL-23/p19 promoter and joint loss of promoter activity after Stat3 and p65 interference.
limitations_preserved: Record IL23A/p19 as cooperative gene transcription, not automatically secreted IL-23 protein or IL-23 receptor activation; preserve Stat3/p65 co-occupancy and tumor-associated context; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Conserved Intergenic Elements and DNA Methylation Cooperate to Regulate Transcription at the il17 Locus
decision_basis: The reviews identify IL17A as a direct STAT3 target during Th17 differentiation; the cited primary study shows STAT3-responsive Il17a promoter activity, endogenous promoter occupancy and lineage-restricted STAT3 binding in Th17 cells.
limitations_preserved: Record IL17A as gene transcription, not automatically secreted IL-17A or IL17 receptor activation; preserve Th17 lineage restriction, promoter STAT3 element and intergenic enhancer context; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Diverse Targets of the Transcription Factor STAT3 Contribute to T Cell Pathogenicity and Homeostasis
decision_basis: The reviews identify IL17F as a STAT3-regulated Th17 cytokine gene; the cited primary study reports STAT3 binding at the Il17f promoter/intergenic locus and STAT3-dependent regulation within the coordinated Il17a-Il17f region.
limitations_preserved: Record IL17F as gene/locus transcription, not automatically secreted IL-17F or IL17 receptor activation; preserve coordinated Il17a-Il17f locus and Th17 context, recognizing that other factors including RORgammaT also contribute; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: IL-21-mediated non-canonical pathway for IL-1beta production in conventional dendritic cells
decision_basis: The review-guided primary study shows an IL-21-induced, NF-kappaB-independent STAT3 pathway at the Il1b promoter in conventional dendritic cells, with lineage-specific chromatin and endogenous transcript/protein output.
limitations_preserved: Record IL1B as STAT3-dependent gene transcription in cDCs, not universal IL1B regulation or automatic IL-1beta secretion/processing; preserve IL-21 stimulus, cDC-specific chromatin context and post-transcriptional processing boundary; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Induction of innate lymphoid cell-derived interleukin-22 by the transcription factor STAT3 mediates protection against intestinal infection
decision_basis: The reviews identify STAT3 as a direct regulator of the Il22 locus; the cited primary study shows STAT3-dependent IL-22 expression in RORgammaT-positive ILC3s, STAT3 occupancy at the Il22 locus and intestinal infection protection.
limitations_preserved: Record IL22 as gene transcription, not automatically secreted IL-22 or IL22 receptor activation; preserve RORgammaT-positive ILC3/Th22 context, STAT3 locus occupancy and intestinal infection model; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Aryl Hydrocarbon Receptor Promotes RORgammaT+ ILCs and Controls Intestinal Immunity and Inflammation
decision_basis: The reviews describe AHR/RORgammaT cooperation at the Il22 locus; the cited primary study shows Ahr and RORgammaT coexpression, locus occupancy/cooperation and synergistic Il22 induction in RORgammaT-positive ILCs.
limitations_preserved: Record IL22 as cooperative gene transcription, not automatically secreted IL-22 or IL22 receptor activation; preserve AHR ligand/RORgammaT-positive ILC context and cooperative locus binding; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Cell-type-restricted binding of the transcription factor NFAT to a distal IL-4 enhancer in vivo; GATA-3-dependent enhancer activity in IL-4 gene regulation
decision_basis: The reviews identify GATA3 binding at IL4 regulatory elements; the cited primary studies show Th2-restricted GATA3 occupancy at an inducible distal IL4 enhancer and GATA3-dependent IL4 enhancer/promoter activity.
limitations_preserved: Record IL4 as gene transcription, not automatically secreted IL-4 or IL4 receptor activation; preserve Th2-cell restriction and distal/intronic enhancer context; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Transcription factors T-bet and Runx3 cooperate to activate Ifng and silence Il4 in T helper type 1 cells
decision_basis: The reviews describe T-bet/RUNX3 cooperation at the IFNG locus; the cited primary study shows both factors bind the Ifng promoter and are required for maximal IFN-gamma production in Th1 cells.
limitations_preserved: Record IFNG as cooperative gene transcription, not automatically secreted IFN-gamma or IFNGR activation; preserve Th1-cell and promoter/enhancer context and distinguish T-bet/RUNX3 cooperation from single-factor sufficiency; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Synergy of IL-12 and IL-18 for IFN-gamma gene expression: IL-12-induced STAT4 contributes to IFN-gamma promoter activation by up-regulating the binding activity of IL-18-induced activator protein 1
decision_basis: The reviews describe IL-12/STAT4 and IL-18/AP-1 cooperation in IFNG transcription; the cited primary study shows STAT4/c-Jun cooperation, AP-1 promoter binding and synergistic IFNG promoter activation without claiming that STAT4 alone directly binds the promoter.
limitations_preserved: Record IFNG as cooperative gene transcription, not automatically secreted IFN-gamma or IFNGR activation; preserve IL-12/STAT4 plus IL-18/AP-1 stimulus pairing and the primary finding that STAT4 facilitates AP-1 rather than acting as a standalone promoter-binding factor; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.
